title: Aster Hobby Gauge-1 Live Steam Engineering Prior Knowledge & 2010 JNR D51 Specification Reconciliation
primary_sources: data/raw_pdfs/aster-manual.pdf (MANUAL OF ASTER MODEL LIVE STEAM ENGINES, 43 pages, J. T. van Riemsdijk / Aster Hobby)
data/raw_pdfs/2010_JNR_D51-standard.pdf (Aster 2010 JNR D51 Standard & Super-Detail Official Spec Sheet)
data/raw_pdfs/d51_illustrations.pdf & data/raw_pdfs/d51_manual.pdf (Assembly Blueprints Sheets 1-37, Templates 1-6 & Japanese Trial-Run Manual)

reconciliation_hierarchy.tier_1_part_dimensions: d51_illustrations.pdf & d51_manual.pdf BOM standard codes (PR-15, PF3-1.9, PN3.2-1, PN7-1.9, SB-ø3/ø4) and 300-DPI blueprint photogrammetry
reconciliation_hierarchy.tier_2_locomotive_specs: 2010_JNR_D51-standard.pdf (1/30 JNR Gauge-1 scale, Type-C boiler class, R2m min curve radius, 7.8 kg reference consist weight)
reconciliation_hierarchy.tier_3_implicit_physics_priors: aster-manual.pdf first-principles design rules whenever assembly drawings leave internal clearances, acoustics, or heat-transfer paths implicit

gauge1_scale_and_adhesion_priors.speed_regime_transition: Adhesion- and cylinder-tractive-effort-limited at starting/low speed; boiler evaporation rate and cutoff-expansion efficiency limited at cruising speed

watanabe_mixed_type.structure: 1 central large flue + 3 small fire tubes + 6 firebox cross/water tubes (300 cc)

van_riemsdijk_type_c.pressure_vessel_part: 12-6 (recessed-bottom circular C1100 copper barrel with stayed end plates & 5 full-length copper smoke tubes; ZERO wet copper side waterlegs)
van_riemsdijk_type_c.firebox_duct_part: 12-4 (separate M2.6x4 bolted SUS304 stainless-steel firebox & rear upward flame-reversal duct lined with Templates 1/2/3 alumina-silica ceramic fiber sheet)

cylinder_and_valve_gear_priors.cross_porting_reason: Allows outside-admission flat bronze D-slide valve (1-6) to retain authentic JNR inside-admission piston-valve external Walschaerts linkage geometry (aster-manual.pdf p.29 Fig.33)
cylinder_and_valve_gear_priors.slide_valve_lift_relief_physics: Unrestrained 0.50 mm vertical play in buckle 1-5 allows D-valve 1-6 to lift off mirror face 1-9 when P_cyl > P_steam_chest + dP_lift, venting trapped condensate/compression overpressure back into steam chest
cylinder_and_valve_gear_priors.expansion_link_slot_radius_rule: R_slot == L_radius_rod (Constant Lead at both FDC and BDC across forward/neutral/reverse)
cylinder_and_valve_gear_priors.drain_cock_type: Suzuki-type mechanically linked 4-port spring-poppet cylinder drain cocks (1-16..19, aster-manual.pdf p.31 Fig.36)

whistle_aero_acoustics_priors.valve_part: 11-1 spring-loaded stainless ball valve unseated by 11-2 pin and 11-3 3-hole cab lever
whistle_aero_acoustics_priors.resonator_part: 11-8 concealed oversized cylindrical brass stopped pipe (OD 6.2 mm, ID 4.30 mm, total length 44.4 mm, stopped cavity L_cav = 29.2 mm)
whistle_aero_acoustics_priors.dummy_scale_whistle_part: 30-2 (static dummy on boiler top; scale <8 mm whistle would squeak ultrasonically >15 kHz)
whistle_aero_acoustics_priors.mounting_and_drainage: Mounted horizontally in warm left firebox-cheek zone (Y=+20.2 mm, Z=+25.5 mm) with 3.2 mm mouth window facing strictly downward (-Z) for continuous gravity condensate drainage (aster-manual.pdf p.17 Fig.16)
whistle_aero_acoustics_priors.two_phase_sound_speed_law: c_mix(T, x) = sqrt(x * gamma_tp(x) * R_steam * T_K), rising from ~362 m/s in cold condensing wet steam (x~0.62) to ~475 m/s in warm dry steam (x~0.96)

safety_pump_lubricator_burner_priors.safety_valve_type: Twin spring-loaded stainless-ball pop valves (28-6 x2)
safety_pump_lubricator_burner_priors.roscoe_ambient_subcooling_law: Condensation displacement rate proportional to max(0, T_sat(P_chest) - T_lubricator_wall(T_amb, v_air))
safety_pump_lubricator_burner_priors.mariotte_sump_level_rule: Beveled air-pipe mouth in 34-2 sump sets constant hydrostatic fuel head equal to 23-1 burner cup height; opening 36-5 cap or solar tank heating breaks vacuum and floods burner
safety_pump_lubricator_burner_priors.clean_alcohol_flame_color: blue (yellow tips indicate fuel-rich flooding or water contamination)

d51_2010_reconciled_specifications.model_name: Aster Hobby 2010 JNR D51 Standard / Super-Detail (1-D-1 Mikado)
d51_2010_reconciled_specifications.boiler_type: Type C (van Riemsdijk stayed copper barrel 12-6 + separate ceramic-lined SUS304 firebox/rear duct 12-4)
